source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Acquire the test results.
3. Identify the failed tests.
4. Review the standards.
5. Verify the results.
6. Document the findings.
7. Contact the appropriate regulatory body/authority.
8. Notify the affected community.
9. Prepare a public statement.
10. Develop a remediation plan.
11. Implement the remediation plan.
12. Schedule follow-up testing.
13. Provide ongoing updates to the public.
14. Analyze root causes.
15. Train personnel.
16. Revise protocols if necessary.
17. Arrange for an external audit.

Remember to follow the communication protocols set by your local authority or health department when reporting these results. Be factual, accurate, and timely in your reporting to ensure public safety and trust.<|end_of_text|>
